about: A double battle where the player's second Pokemon faints with a third to take its place: Twins Amy & Mimi in the Azalea Gym (konefr's level-20 bugs) against a scratch copy of Paolo's Bugsy save with a level-30 Pawmot, a level-5 Magikarp and a level-30 Baxcalibur, put on the twins' platform facing them. The Spinarak's Shadow Sneak faints the Magikarp, the party screen asks who goes in its place, gym.py's player sends the Baxcalibur -- the first with HP that is not already out -- and the battle is played to its end: the twins send Karrablast and Shelmet, and the turns after one of their places is left empty play on to 'You defeated Twins Amy & Mimi!' with no assert (before 757cb7ff3 the damage of the first move after it asserted, RawSpeedOrder reading the empty place's party index 6).

lines: Twins Amy & Mimi sent out Shelmet!
